content:
Overview

Dundee is a city in Scotland with a population of 148,000. Scotland’s sunniest city, a vibrant waterfront destination on the Tay known for the V&A Dundee museum, video game industry, and its medieval Old Town. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Sunshine is limited, with about 135 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
